fingerprintAlgorithm: FNV-1a32 + DJB2-32 over node ID and full JSON-serialized reactions, including triggers, conditional branches, variable values and transitions; serialized character count also compared
scope: All 179 referenced frames and their descendants; metadata indexed the complete page once. Read-only calls only. PA2 PDF and Figma nodes/IDs/connections were not edited.
verificationBoundary: Stored prototype topology and before/after reaction fingerprints, not live Figma prototype playback. Conditional outcomes/variables were not executed or fabricated. Browser business behavior is separately tested against the real local app/API/database.
